subsystem.note: See parity/gate_item2.orchestrator-walk.ledger.json for the subsystem-level note. This ledger is the third of the subsystem's three files and the one that stays entirely 'not-ported' (deferred) in this change -- see D-0801 and the per-entry reason.

file.note: The inventory is `pytest --collect-only -q` on the source at 65f36c5, in collection order; all 6 pass there (re-run 2026-08-29 against the read-only clone of interlock at 65f36c5, `PYTHONPATH=src PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/gate_item2/ -p no:cacheprovider`: 34 passed, of which 6 are this file's). Skipped entirely at pytest collection time on non-Linux hosts via `pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not _LINUX, ...)`; unaffected by that here since every entry is deferred rather than run.

target_only_tests.why: None. No target file exists yet -- every entry is deferred.

entries.reason: Deferred, not a translation gap: this file drives tests.fault_injection.controller.Controller / execute_case / assert_invariants against SESSION_ADAPTER from tests/fault_injection/session_driver.py -- the fault-injection harness itself, real SIGKILL and all. Continuo's port of that harness (test/fault_injection/, feat/continuo-fault-injection-port, HEAD 16a9c2c at the time this belt paused) carries a SESSION_ADAPTER whose execution-path methods (bootstrap, spawn, roleArguments, observer, invariantQueries, queryParameters, effectKeys, holderOf) all deliberately throw ContractViolation: its own header states the four session-start cases are 'a follow-on on the session belt landing' (D-0601) that has not yet been done, distinct from the session belt itself (D-0301/D-0302, PR #61) which HAS landed. So the six node ids here need a SessionAdapter re-bound to src/supervisor.ts and src/session/claude_cli_provider.ts before they can run meaningfully, which is fault_injection's own file to change, not gate_item2's. Ratified as a follow-on task (2026-08-29, human decision via secretary, option (a')): gate_item2 ships as 28/34 and the SessionAdapter follow-on + these six cases + fault_injection's own four full-profile session-start manifest cases are dispatched as a separate task. A faithful draft of all six cases against the current controller.ts / manifest.ts APIs is held at (gitignored, not in this ledger's target file) tmp/session-driver-harness.draft.test.ts on this task's branch (feat/continuo-gate-item2-port) as a handoff asset for the follow-on worker -- it 1:1-translates Controller/executeCase/assertInvariants exactly as the ported test/fault_injection/cases.test.ts already calls them, and is expected to need rework once the adapter is real (explicitly accepted by the human decision). What unblocks this ledger: the SessionAdapter follow-on landing, at which point this entry set is replaced with real target_ids and dispositions in a follow-up PR.
